name: coeos-memory
description: One long-term memory for Claude Chat, Cowork and Code: search a wiki compiled from your past sessions, read an article, add an entry.
long_description: Gives Claude three tools on a folder of plain markdown on this machine, and holds the settings of the whole memory: the folder, an optional decision model and an optional LightRAG instance (alone or managed with Coeos-RAG). The Claude Code hooks installed by the coeos-memory package read the same settings. The server makes no network call unless a decision model is configured.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Find the wiki articles that answer a question.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Return one wiki article in full.

tools.name: memory_capture
tools.description: Add an entry to today's log of the memory.

memory_dir.title: Memory folder
memory_dir.description: The vault: the folder that holds daily/ and knowledge/. The same one you open in Obsidian.

decision_endpoint.title: Decision model: API address
decision_endpoint.description: Optional. The address before /systemone, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Empty: no decision model, search uses keywords.

decision_model.title: Decision model: model name
decision_model.description: For example ~typesafe/jev-latest on OpenRouter. The tilde is part of that name.

decision_api_key.title: Decision model: API key
decision_api_key.description: Only if the server needs one. The Claude Code hooks cannot read this field: see docs/settings.md.

lightrag_url.title: LightRAG: instance address
lightrag_url.description: Optional. Address and port of the LightRAG instance that receives the wiki, for example http://localhost:9621. With Coeos-RAG, give the instance's address, not the console's. Empty: nothing is sent.

rag_sources.title: LightRAG: files to send
rag_sources.description: Optional. Comma-separated glob patterns. Empty: the wiki articles. {vault} stands for the memory folder.
